sole_research_target_acknowledgement: My sole research target is the full quadratic-form bounded-density statement for arbitrary independent coordinate densities bounded by one and every real symmetric matrix with at least three eigenvalues of magnitude at least one.

latest_substantive_result.scope: Diffuse rank-two product projections have an explicit L3 quadratic-pushforward bound; this yields sign-free scalar-pivot smoothing for exact-rank-three forms when the residual two-frame is diffuse, and closes the one-heavy/two-delocalized stress family.

first_unresolved_implication: Aggregate the at most three residual-heavy coordinates with a useful scalar pivot when the residual two-frame is not diffuse, including near-light-cone pivots, before reciprocal local-determinant payment; then make the finite-core argument stable under arbitrary additional spectral components.
next_attempt: Combine the new rank-two L3 transport with the finite-core flag decomposition to prove a finite-core plus diffuse-remainder hybrid smoothing theorem.
